purpose: Test sensitivity of non-asymptotic temporal field differences to iterative stopping tolerances
unchanged: MMS, forcing, mesh, Euler temporal scheme, other discretizations, initial conditions and output precision
checks: solver exits zero and log ends with End
all physical steps meet outer convergence criterion
same cell centers and endpoint time
archive original inputs, modified inputs, image ID, command and logs
analysis: Compare same-dt fields with baseline, then recompute temporal difference norm ratio, cosine, best-fit scale and first-order defect. Record all outcomes; no numerical accuracy PASS follows from tighter tolerances.
attribution: A field change comparable to baseline timestep differences supports iterative sensitivity, but does not isolate a specific linear or outer-loop cause. A negligible change leaves other explanations open.
